notes: Live https://docs.composio.dev/toolkits/enrich_layer (slug ENRICH_LAYER, version 00000000_00) lists Tools: 9 and Triggers: 0. Triggers were not counted. The header slug is not a tool. composio_tools is that live count. index_tools is the assigned index count 9, which matches the live page. origin/main has no runner/connectors/enrich-layer manifest (git cat-file exit 128), so origin_ops is 0. Official OpenAPI https://enrichlayer.com/docs/api/v2/openapi.json servers url is https://enrichlayer.com and BearerAuth is HTTP bearer. allowedHosts is only enrichlayer.com. baseUrl is https://enrichlayer.com/api/v2. No setup field selects a host, and no input schema contains a free-form request URL. Profile and company URLs are query values on that fixed host. Each live tool is one JSON GET: disposable-email, company, profile, profile/resolve/email, find/company/role/, resolve/phone, credit-balance, company/resolve, and profile/resolve. Composio company_profile_url is the official url query. Composio linkedin_profile_url is profile_url. Composio include_skills is the official skills enum include or exclude, not a boolean. Composio company_country is company_location. Composio company is company_domain, which the official schema describes as a company name or domain. Composio job_title is title. enrich_profile and the other credit-adding switches are not on these nine tools and were not added. GET calls are body-less. Success bodies are JSON objects. missing_http is empty. mapped 9 + missing_still 0 = live count 9. No live provider call was made.
